; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; Print a message to the terminal window, prepended with the name of ; the calling subprogram. ; ; :Categories: ; ; SST pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; Mats Löfdahl, Institute for Solar Physics ; ; ; :Params: ; ; msg : in, type=strarr ; ; The message to be printed. ; ; ; :Keywords: ; ; ; ; ; ; ; :History: ; ; 2025-02-19 : MGL. First version. ; ;- pro red_message, msg ;; Get the name of this subprogram and in particular of where it's ;; called from. inam = red_subprogram(/low, calling = inam1) ;; Then print the message case n_elements(msg) of 0 : return 1 : red_strflow, inam1 + ' : ' + msg else : begin ;; If a strarr, we don't want to prepend the subprogram name to ;; each line. msg1 = msg msg1[0] = inam1 + ' : ' + msg1[0] red_strflow, msg1 end endcase end
